privacy.title: Privacy Policy

intro.title: 1. Introduction
intro.text: Mama & Bébé is published by KSA MEDIA LLC. This policy explains what data the app collects, where it is kept, who processes it for us, how long it is kept and how to erase it.

collection.title: 2. Data collected
collection.text: Depending on what you use, the app processes:
collection.accountDesc: your email address and password, handled by Firebase Authentication to sign you in.
collection.profileDesc: first name, last name (optional), country, city, age range, whether this is your first pregnancy, last period date, due date, height and pre-pregnancy weight, cycle length if you track fertility, and your chosen language.
collection.healthDesc: weight, blood pressure, blood glucose, symptoms, medical appointments, reminders and tasks, with any notes you add. The app draws no diagnosis from them.
collection.medicalDesc: if you choose to tell us, whether a healthcare professional has flagged gestational diabetes, pregnancy hypertension or a twin pregnancy. It is used only to adjust the reminders offered to you.
collection.emergencyDesc: the names and numbers of the people you add yourself.
collection.deviceDesc: baby movements, contractions, hospital bag, hydration, Ramadan tracking, daily checklist and saved articles. They are not sent to our servers.
collection.assistantDesc: it runs entirely on your phone. Your messages are neither sent to a server nor saved.
collection.technicalDesc: when an error occurs, a technical report (error description, screen, device model and operating system, app version) with a pseudonymous identifier derived from your account, never your email address.

usage.title: 3. Use of data
usage.text: Your data is used only to:
usage.item1: provide pregnancy tracking and schedule your reminders on your phone;
usage.item2: sync your data across your devices when you are signed in;
usage.item3: fix app errors using technical reports.
usage.disclaimer: We do not sell or rent your data, and we do not use it for advertising or profiling.

processors.title: 4. Service providers
processors.text: These services process data on our behalf, only to run the app:
processors.firebaseDesc: sign-in, database, and checking that requests come from the genuine app (App Check, using Apple App Attest or Google Play Integrity).
processors.expoDesc: delivers app updates; it receives technical device information (IP address, app version) when the app checks for an update.
processors.fontsDesc: loads fonts when you generate your PDF journal; Google then receives your device's IP address.

storage.title: 5. Storage, security and transfers
storage.text: Your account data is stored on Google Firebase servers. Traffic with those servers is encrypted (HTTPS/TLS), and access rules restrict each record to its owner. The publisher is based in the United States, and Google and our providers may process your data outside your country, including in the United States.

retention.title: 6. Retention
retention.text: Your account data is kept as long as your account exists and erased as soon as you delete it; we keep no copy. Data kept on your phone stays there until you erase it, delete your account or uninstall the app. Error reports are deleted automatically by Sentry at the end of its retention period.

rights.title: 7. Your rights (GDPR)
rights.text: You exercise your rights directly in the app:
rights.accessDesc: “{{settings}}” → “{{dataSection}}” → “{{export}}” gives you a copy of your profile and health data, including your declared medical follow-up.
rights.rectificationDesc: anything you entered can be edited in the app.
rights.deletionDesc: “{{profile}}” → “{{dangerZone}}” → “{{deleteFromProfile}}”, or “{{settings}}” → “{{dataSection}}” → “{{deleteFromSettings}}”. Deletion is immediate and permanent: your account, the data stored on our servers and the local copy on your phone.
rights.consentDesc: turn off the declared medical follow-up at any time in “{{settings}}” → “{{medical}}”, without deleting the rest of your account.

contact.title: 8. Contact
contact.text: For any question about your data or your rights:

guestMode.title: 9. Guest mode
guestMode.text: Without an account, your data stays on your phone and is not sent to our servers; only technical error reports (section 2) leave it. To erase it: “{{settings}}” → “{{dataSection}}” → “{{eraseGuest}}”, or uninstall the app.
